create_OneHotEncode_transform: create a OneHotEncode transform with a specified number of classes for one-hot encoding labels
encode_labels_one_hot: encode integer labels into one-hot encoded tensors using the OneHotEncode transform
test_OneHotEncode_single_sample: test the OneHotEncode transform on a single sample with integer label input
test_OneHotEncode_batch: test the OneHotEncode transform on a batch of samples with multiple labels per sample
review_OneHotEncode_multi_output: review the OneHotEncode class for multi-output label support in ClassyVision accuracy meters
